Scaffold a project from skeleton archetypes

Usage: rune init [OPTIONS] [SLUG_OR_DIR]

Arguments:
  [SLUG_OR_DIR]  Project slug or directory (created if missing)

Options:
      --module <DIR>       Scaffold a rune module for deck authoring
      --lang <LANG>        Project language archetype [default: rust] [possible values: rust, python, shell]
      --purpose <PURPOSE>  Project purpose archetype [default: tool] [possible values: tool, module, spine]
      --skeleton <DIR>     Skeleton repository root
      --brief <BRIEF>      Short project description used for ${BRIEF} [default: ""]
      --quest              Bind the scaffolded project as the active quest
      --json               Output results as JSON
      --no-color           Disable ANSI colors
  -h, --help               Print help
